# Safe Zone Ready

Safe Zone Ready is a free checker for ad stills. Drop a PNG, JPEG or WebP and see where Instagram Reels, Stories, Feed, YouTube Shorts and TikTok place captions, profile rows and buttons on the offer.

Local checks do not upload. Scoring runs in the browser. Overlays are approximate guardrails from public platform guidance and measured templates. They are not a certification from Meta, Google or TikTok.

Optional AI edits (when live) need a Google sign-in, store the image for at most 72 hours, send it to Google Gemini, and include a SynthID watermark.

This file is a courtesy for language models. It is not a ranking signal on Google.

## Pages

- / : Combined overlay checker for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.
- /meta : Instagram Reels, Stories and Feed 4:5 safe zone checker. Deep links from metasafezone.com land here.
- /youtube-shorts : YouTube Shorts title, channel, CTA card and right-hand rail.
- /tiktok : Standard TikTok in-feed guardrail. Official overlays change with caption length.
- /privacy : How local checks, AI edits, cookies and UK GDPR rights work.
- /terms : Terms of use, credits, affiliation and acceptable use.

Canonical host: https://safezoneready.com
